QuestInfo.name: Flustered Explorer
QuestInfo.0: While waiting for maintenance to be finished on the ship, you see a flustered girl. Talk to #bSugar#k.
QuestInfo.1: While waiting for maintenance to be finished on the ship, you see a flustered girl, who says she's also an Explorer. She's misplaced her boarding ticket, though. Hit #i3800571# boxes at the harbor with regular attacks and see if you can find her #i4033914##b#t4033914##k.
QuestInfo.2: While waiting for maintenance to be finished on the ship, you see a flustered girl, who says she's also an Explorer. She's misplaced her boarding ticket, though. Luckily, you manage to find it for her.

0.0: Um... er... excuse me... r\n#L0##b(The girl is too flustered to speak.) Hi, what's up?#l\n#k
0.1: I... I... I lost my #bboat ticket#k. \r\n#L0##bThe ticket to get to Victoria Island?#l\n#k
0.2: I lost it.... in a #bbox#k... somewhere nearby... I didn't want the boat to leave without me, so I was going to ask the captain to wait... but I'm too scared... \r\n#L0##bThat boat isn't going anywhere for a while, and they wouldn't leave without ME. I'll help search for your ticket.#l\n#k
